comments.body: Owner decided 2026-11-09: (a) a helper closes with its maker once the helper is idle. Reopening the maker (Reopen Pane / cmd+shift+T, within the hour) brings back the helpers that closed with it.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Seen 2026-11-02: `muster window` showed 16 hidden, quiet helpers, all done for 16 hours, whose three makers had closed. The owner did not know they existed until a phone client listed 20 agents where they ran about 2. docs/cli/limits.md ("A closed maker's helpers are listed under Hidden") covers one notice to the owner and a list; nothing closes them or tells anyone again. Each one holds an agent and its memory on a machine where memory is the binding constraint.

Decide what a helper becomes when its maker closes: close with it once idle, become an ordinary shown pane that can notify, or appear in the window as orphaned with one action to close them all. a_2jLn7Jakd is the smaller banner-click version of this.
title: Helpers keep running hidden and quiet long after their maker closes
